# Adventure — Narrow-Phone Delta Plan

The Awtsmoos gives four directions and two choices room inside one finite hand;
Awtsmoos.com must never let a control equation widen the world beyond the glass where the player stands.

## Proven defect

At requested 320×568, Chrome reports visual viewport width 320, document client width 320, but layout/content width 352 and document scroll width 352.

Exact cause from live element geometry:
- Adventure content width should be 304px after 8px left/right app padding.
- D-pad currently consumes 184px.
- Gap is 10px.
- Game actions consume 150px.
- 184 + 10 + 150 = 344px, which forces the footer grid item and then every grid row to 344px.
- HUD, playfield, canvas, objective, and control row therefore render from x=8 to x=352.
- Shared player-shell is not the culprit; its launcher stays x=294–340 and panel width is viewport-capped.

## Preservation strategy

The Adventure tree is actively modified by concurrent work. Do not rewrite existing `dpad.css` or `actions.css`. Instead:

- Rewrite only the tiny `controls.css` manifest, preserving both existing imports and adding one final `styles/controls/narrow-polish.css` import.
- Create `narrow-polish.css` as a late override.
- At max-width 360px, keep the controls side-by-side but use 44×44 D-pad cells, 4px gaps, and 6px D-pad padding.
- This yields a roughly 154px D-pad.
- Keep 10px control gap and narrow actions to 140px: 154 + 10 + 140 = 304px exactly.
- Constrain narrow HUD title text with min-width 0 + ellipsis so the top row can never become a second width source.
- Add `:active` feedback for Pause/Restart/overlay restart because those controls already transition and hover but currently have no pressed state.
- Preserve all gameplay event ids/classes and touch wiring.

## Verification

At 320×568 require:
- layout viewport/client/content width 320;
- document scrollWidth 320;
- every HUD/canvas/objective/control edge <=320;
- D-pad buttons remain >=44×44;
- action buttons remain >=44px high;
- overlay card stays contained;
- player-shell launcher remains reachable;
- no runtime exceptions attributable to the CSS change.

Recheck 390×844 to prove the narrow override does not regress the already clean 390 layout.
